claim: Library 2 pooled-LNP count: the paper states 115 of 120 LNPs were stable, pooled and injected, but only 110 of the 120 printed hydrodynamic diameters fall inside the paper's own 20-200 nm inclusion band.
locus_A: Results: 'We formulated 120 LNPs, of which 115 were stable, pooled, and injected'; Fig S5f/S6 captions repeat '115 LNPs'
locus_B: SI p15 library-2 table, Diameter (nm) column: 9 rows outside 20-200 nm (LNP 3 = 290, 11 = 12.5, 23 = 15, 29 = 264, 37 = 270, 50 = 16, 68 = 17, 92 = 297, 103 = 545), leaving 110 in band
why: The diameter gate should be a SUPERSET of the pooled set, because pooling also required a single-inflection autocorrelation curve which the table does not print. A superset cannot be smaller than the set it contains. Library 1 behaves correctly (119 in band vs 111 pooled, a superset of +8); library 2 is short by 5. Either 5 printed diameters are wrong, or 5 out-of-band LNPs were pooled anyway, or the stated 115 is wrong. Not resolvable from the paper: the SI never marks which LNPs were pooled.

claim: Methods describe an in vivo gene-editing experiment that the paper does not contain.
locus_A: Methods, 'Cell Isolation & Staining': 'Cells were isolated 24 (for screens) or 96 (for in vivo gene editing) hours after injection with LNPs'
locus_B: No figure, table, Results sentence or SI panel reports any gene editing; the cargo throughout is a DNA barcode or a control siRNA, and no Cas9, sgRNA, TIDE or indel measurement appears anywhere
why: Reads as Methods boilerplate carried over from a sibling paper of the same laboratory. Recorded because a reader scanning Methods for an admissible endpoint would find the phrase 'in vivo gene editing' and wrongly conclude an editing-efficiency readout exists. It does not.

claim: Methods describe an ICAM2 protein-abundance readout, which WOULD be corpus-admissible, but no ICAM2 value is reported anywhere.
locus_A: Methods, 'Endothelial RNA interference': 'protein expression was determined via flow cytometry. ICAM2 MFI in siLuc-treated mice (for each background) was normalized to 100 percent'
locus_B: 'ICAM' occurs exactly twice in the 165357-character article XML, both inside that one Methods paragraph, and zero times in the 25876-character SI text. Only the non-targeting control siLuciferase is ever injected, and its ICAM2 MFI is defined as 100 percent
why: This is the single admissible readout CLASS in the paper (protein-silencing MFI) and it has no data. A targeting siRNA is never used, so there is no knockdown to measure; the described experiment can only produce the normalisation constant. Load-bearing for the zero verdict: it is the one place a delivery endpoint could have hidden.

claim: Number of cell types in the fluorescence biodistribution panel: text says 13, the panel plots 12.
locus_A: Results: 'we quantified Alexa-647 mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) in 13 cell types'; Fig 2 caption: 'barcode delivery to 13 cell types isolated by FACS'
locus_B: SI Fig S1f (SI p3) carries exactly 12 bar labels: Lung Macs, Lung Immune, Lung ECs, Kupffer Cells, Hepatocytes, Liver ECs, Liver Immune, Heart ECs, Heart Immune, Kidney ECs, Kidney Macs, Kidney Immune
why: SI Fig S1c defines cell types across five tissues including spleen B and T cells; S1f omits the spleen entries, so the panel plots a subset. Consistent with Results stating that delivery 'could not reliably be quantified' in most cell types. Recorded as a figure/text count mismatch, not as an error in a value, since no value was taken.

claim: The normalisation is specified in one sentence in Methods but is a two-stage procedure in the SI.
locus_A: Methods, 'Barcode Sequencing Normalization', complete text: 'Counts for each particle, per cell type, were normalized to the barcoded LNP mixture applied to cells or injected into the mouse.'
locus_B: SI Fig S4e (SI p13) shows three stacked tables: raw counts; 'Normalized Counts (%)' = count / column total x 100; and 'Normalized to input Counts (%)' = the input-normalised ratios RE-CLOSED to sum 100
what_we_emitted: nothing, but the reconstruction is recorded in 01_si_tables.json
why: The Methods sentence names only the input normalisation and does not state the per-sample compositional step, nor the re-closure to 100 that follows it. Both were needed to reproduce the worked example, and both were recovered from the figure rather than the text. This is why the residual is reported against SI Fig S4e and not against Methods.

claim: Figure 1 caption describes a panel (g) that the Results never reference.
locus_A: Fig 1 caption: '(g) Comparison of fluorescence and QUANT-based methods of analyzing nanoparticle biodistribution.'
locus_B: Results text walks Fig 1a-f and then moves to Fig 2; no sentence cites Fig 1g
why: Cosmetic. Recorded only because an SI contents page or caption being off by one against its own panels is a measured hazard in this project, and a reviewer re-deriving the panel inventory should not treat the absence as an extraction failure.

claim: Library 2 uses a PEG-lipid that the paper never draws.
locus_A: SI p14 structure band draws exactly four PEG-lipids: C14PEG2000, C16PEG2000, C18PEG2000, C14PEG3000, under the caption 'Library 1: 128 LNPs (4 PEG-lipids)'
locus_B: SI p15 library-2 table contains five distinct PEG-lipid combinations, 24 formulations each: C14PEG2000, C16PEG2000, C18PEG2000, C14PEG3000 and C18PEG3000
why: The drawn set is exactly library 1's set (4/4, and 32 formulations each = 128, matching the drawn caption). Library 2 adds C18PEG3000, whose structure is never drawn. No consequence here because no PEG structure is emitted (block length is a distribution), but it means the drawn structure band does not cover the whole corpus of components used.
